en: Vintage multi-view postcard with two black‑and‑white photographs. The left image shows a tall round stone tower attached to a building, partly hidden by trees and a wooden fence; it is labeled "Pfarrhaus mit Turm". The right image shows a narrow street lined with traditional half‑timbered or gabled houses with shopfronts and people in the street; it is labeled "Partie an der Friedrichstraße". Beneath the images is the printed caption "Gruß aus Osterburken". The lower part of the card contains handwritten cursive text in blue ink.
